purpose: Provide one production-safe season/preseason football risk score for every player in the authoritative 162-player comparison universe when weekly Step 4 distribution risk is not populated.

relationship_to_step_4.production_resolution_rule: Use populated locked Step 4 normalized risk for weekly/in-season weekly comparisons; otherwise use this production preseason/season-level profile. Never combine both risk scores.

hard_block_rules: authoritative player universe is not exactly 162 unique players
any availability, reliability, or sustainability input is missing, non-finite, or outside [0,10]
final risk score is non-finite or outside [0,1]
ADP, draft price, market-value labels, sportsbook data, or implied probability changes the risk score
raw injury/status text adds a second injury penalty beyond the audited availability input
preseason risk and Step 4 weekly risk are combined or double counted
risk profile changes projection, ceiling, role, environment, probability, EV, or sportsbook calculations
